title: All roles

help.title: About roles
help.overview: A role is a set of permissions: what someone may see, add, change or delete. Give each person the roles that fit their work.

sections.title: Manage roles
items: Create a role, then choose what it may do on each page.
A role marked for sign-up is given to people who create an account themselves; they appear under Users. Everyone else appears under Administration, your team.
Some built-in roles can't be changed or deleted.

sections.title: Before you change one
items: Check who has a role before you change or delete it: everyone who has it is affected.
A deleted role can be restored.
